displayAddress: Stanley Road, Bournemouth, Family Home Needing Work.
description:
Built, we think, in the last 25 years, this two double bedroom, semi-detached house is set just at the end of Stanley Road in Springbourne.

Stanley Road is one-way running West to East from Windham Road.

The house is essentially modern but the decorations are now tired and do require updating.

The driveway has space for at least one vehicle or even two with a little adjustment, and the rear garden is a deceptively good size too.

From the driveway, a path leads to the front door and this leads to the: 

ENTRANCE HALL
There is a good sized CLOAKS CUPBOARD to the left and then doors lead to:

LIVING ROOM
There are double french doors leading to the garden and to the left, the stairs up to the bedrooms and bathroom. There is a further window to the side along with ample space for both sofa and dining suites.

KITCHEN
Window to the front and fitted with a selection of units and worktops. There is a sink by the window and an inset gas hob with electric oven under (neither tested) along with spaces for washing machine and fridge/freezer. To one corner is the wall mounted gas fired central heating boiler (not tested).

GROUND FLOOR CLOAKROOM
This has a small window to the front and is fitted with a WC and corner hand basin.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING
Access hatch to loft, doors to:

BEDROOM ONE
Window to rear, space for cdouble bed and wardrobes etc...

BEDROOM TWO
Window to front and also a full double bedroom. Corner storage cupboard.

BATHROOM
Window to side aspectand fitted with a white suite comprising bath, WC and pedestal basin.

OUTSIDE
To the front, the house has as short path to the front door witha a railing fence providing the boundry to the pavement.
To the right side of the house is a driveway that gives off-street parking for at lease one car but could be extended for maybe one more. A gated fence then leads to the rear garden which can also be accessed via the french doors in the living room.
It is paved and shingled for low maintenance  and is a surprisinly good size as it benefits form the width of the drive as well. There is a serviceable shed to the right and some built in seating in the corner.
